title: Wrapped Crisp Italian Lamb Wrap
description: A bitter and crisp one-pot Italian dish featuring lamb loin chops, wrapped in leaves and steamed to perfection, suitable for plant-based friendly diets with some adjustments.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the lamb loin chops to the marinade and coat evenly, letting it sit for at least 30 minutes.
Wrap each lamb loin chop in a collard green leaf, making sure to secure the leaf with a toothpick if necessary.
Place the wrapped lamb chops in a large talavera plate or a heatproof dish with a lid.
Add the chopped radicchio around the lamb chops and pour the venetian style wine, if using.
Cover the dish with a lid and steam the lamb chops in the oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes to crisp the leaves.
Let the lamb chops rest for a few minutes before serving.
